lines: Trusted sources have informed us of a new order to increase the patrol frequency around the downtown area, as a result of the ramping up of the attacks by resistance cells.
This info has been forwarded to the cells, but this is also a caution for others.
These patrolmen will be high-wired and easily aggravated, so we would like to warn everyone to keep to curfew and, if possible, avoid coming into downtown altogether.
